name: toggle-group
description: Single- or multi-select group of toggle buttons over native radio/checkbox controls, with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation and native l-model binding

changes.note: data-state="on" / "off" on the items is now declared. The controller has always reflected every control's checked property onto its item wrapper (that is the whole styling hook — the real radio/checkbox is visually hidden), but the manifest declared no states at all. 0.8-10's undeclared-attribute rule now makes this class of drift impossible: an attribute a component's CSS selects on that its manifest never declares fails the registry gate.

item.description: One toggle button — a <label> wrapping a native control and its text; repeated per option

control.description: The native radio (single mode) or checkbox (multi mode) input carrying the option's value; visually hidden but the accessible, focusable, l-model-bindable control

label.description: Visible option text; provides the control's accessible name via the wrapping label

off.description: The item's control is unchecked. The controller reflects it on init and on every change; it is the default, so an item that has never been touched still carries it

on.description: The item's control is checked — the pressed appearance. The controller writes it; nothing else should

mode.description: single (radiogroup, one value) or multi (independent toggles, array value)

required_attrs: role="radiogroup" on root in single mode; role="group" in multi mode
type="radio" on each control in single mode; type="checkbox" in multi mode
a wrapping <label> (or aria-label) giving every control an accessible name

keyboard.Tab: moves into the group to the single roving tab-stop (the checked control, else the first enabled one)
keyboard.ArrowRight/ArrowDown: move focus to the next enabled control (wrapping); in single mode focus-follows-selection
keyboard.ArrowLeft/ArrowUp: move focus to the previous enabled control (wrapping); in single mode focus-follows-selection
keyboard.Space/Enter: toggle the focused control (select in single mode)

a11y.notes: The controls are REAL <input type="radio"|"checkbox"> elements, so the platform provides the pressed/checked semantics and l-model binds through the engine's native radio (string) / checkbox-array (array) paths with no engine changes. The controller adds only roving tabindex, single-mode exclusivity for uncontrolled use, the [data-state] styling hook, and a faqir:change notification. Design note: multi mode uses native checkbox aria-checked rather than button aria-pressed specifically so array l-model works natively.
